notes.title: Patch 1.4.1 - New map, unlocked special content
notes.notes:
Hello, Last Mortem players!
Today we released Patch 1.4.1 which is the major patch of this year. The aim of this update is to bring more playable content to your screens - mostly maps! 

The long-in-development map Naval Strike is now available in the game! It does not include everything we wanted, but it works great with the already included weapons and game mechanisms.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910367/3bfc70b15962d6607582a5e05adc3265c2a60186.png

Naval Strike is a considerably large map intended for boots-on-the-ground gameplay. It is located on the abandoned island which has been part of the inter-continental highway structure. The battle destroyed the bridge and outpost on the ground. The map is set in the autumn environment.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910367/07600a8f62ca8c0ec7ed1f7ad871e78edee0ed1e.png

We made a decision to make Favela Night (former only-Halloween map) and Winter Mansion (former only-Christmas map) available during the last months of this year. You now have more maps to choose from!

Small fixes and changes can be spotted in the gameplay! We wish you enjoyable last months of this year in Last Mortem!

notes.title: Update 1.3.7
notes.notes:
Hello Last Mortem players! 
Today, we are here with another regular update, the penultimate update of 2021. 

But before we jump into the changelog, we are announcing that the title Last Mortem has as of 12/5/2021 more than 10k registered player accounts!

We invite you to celebrate this milestone, which was one of our set goals for this game. We sent to each of you who registered until 5/12/2021 the new legendary weapon which won't be available to get in the future. The name of the weapon is symbolic - Triumph, it's a secondary revolver with great stats. Celebrate our milestone together with us by using the Triumph!

The newest patch 1.3.7 comes with various quality-of-life improvements. 
- Gun Race game mode now includes 2 new possible loadouts - one with silver and gold classes of weapons and only-sniper loadout
- the gameplay now includes counting your killstreak such as double kill, triple kill, killing spree, etc.
- Sniper rifles with fullscreen scopes has now a new variety of scope styles
- we added the long-awaited Offline Mode - finally you can play the game also without an internet connection
- one of the old Alpha maps is back under the name - Tropical City. The map has been redesigned, includes better AI pathfinding, fixed colliders, and other changes
- Damage of the Helicopter killstreak was increased
- changing the quality settings will change also the view distance of the player camera - by this step we want to save even more fps for players with weaker machines
- the patch comes also with other minor bug fixes, optimization changes, changes in gameplay, etc.

[previewyoutube=b9fI4t1yA8A;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Shotgun Time - Patch 1.3.1
notes.notes:
Greetings Last Mortem players! The new patch is here and it includes some crazy new content. Say hello to our limited time offer - Shotgun Time!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910367/ab030c4ca8183edfc7d11003c05bc6532dba2fa1.jpg
This update comes with 3 new weapons, 2 of them are shotguns. Both of these shotgun weapons and two older ones are now available in the Store! Make sure to pick them up as they won't stay long!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910367/1fce633cf44aed9881fda0b00464d20ab554b8dd.png
Say hello to a Legendary shotgun weapon called Slayer King! The weapon has 8 shots per reload, bloody skin, and holographic sight (yes, it might be not practical for a shotgun weapon, anyway it is a nice addition)!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910367/915eb45fd8a65d6a17f70e0c02bb63b15f8e9251.png
The second new shotgun weapon is called Monster Shotgun. It is a double-barrel shotgun with two powerful shots per reload!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910367/bd3b1784a01ce3cbab3c9002ed9f289f4bd8e11e.png
The third new weapon which is not the shotgun is the M1919, a very powerful support weapon with 120 rounds per reload and great damage. But expect also horrible recoil.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910367/7f7ff384fc2b626a82daa2312de78dc5bae92fd8.png
This patch comes with many bug fixes and changes mostly in the XP/Level infrastructure. This infrastructure is not fully finished yet so you can expect more changes with it in the future. There are also fixes in the Oil Rig map, changed a few weapon settings, and match infrastructure. 

We hope you will like this new update, enjoy the game and stay updated for the new content!
